actions: OPEN I-O ACCOUNTS OUTPUT POSTINGS-OUT STATEMENTS-OUT

rules.sentence: When `WS-ACCOUNTS-STATUS` is not `'00'`, it accepts `WS-RUN-DATE` from its command line; opens `ACCOUNTS` to update and `POSTINGS-OUT` and `STATEMENTS-OUT` for output; and stops the run.

When `WS-ACCOUNTS-STATUS` is `'00'`, it accepts `WS-RUN-DATE` from its command line; opens `ACCOUNTS` to update and `POSTINGS-OUT` and `STATEMENTS-OUT` for output; reads `ACCOUNTS`; repeats its loop until `WS-ACCOUNTS-STATUS` is `'10'` (`ACCOUNTS-AT-END`); closes `ACCOUNTS`, `POSTINGS-OUT`, and `STATEMENTS-OUT`; and stops the run.
When `CA-CYCLE-DAY` is `WS-RUN-DAY` and `CA-STATUS` is not `'C'` (not `CA-CLOSED`), it performs `CLOSE-CYCLE` and reads `ACCOUNTS`.
When `CA-CYCLE-DAY` is not `WS-RUN-DAY` or `CA-STATUS` is `'C'` (`CA-CLOSED`), it reads `ACCOUNTS`.

actions: CALL 'intcalc' USING CA-PRODUCT CA-STATEMENT-BALANCE RETURNING WS-INTEREST-CENTS

rules.sentence: When `CA-PAID-IN-FULL` is not `'Y'` (not `CA-WAS-PAID-IN-FULL`) and `CA-STATEMENT-BALANCE` is more than zero; `WS-INTEREST` is more than zero; and rewriting `CARD-ACCOUNT` fails on its key, it sets `WS-INTEREST` to zero, calls `INTCALC`, computes `WS-INTEREST` as `WS-INTEREST-CENTS / 100`, adds `WS-INTEREST` to `CA-BALANCE`, performs `POST-INTEREST`, calls `MINPAY`, performs `WRITE-STATEMENT`, sets `CA-STATEMENT-BALANCE` to `CA-BALANCE`, sets `CA-PAID-IN-FULL` to `'N'`, rewrites `CARD-ACCOUNT`, and stops the run.

When `CA-PAID-IN-FULL` is not `'Y'` (not `CA-WAS-PAID-IN-FULL`) and `CA-STATEMENT-BALANCE` is more than zero; `WS-INTEREST` is more than zero; and rewriting `CARD-ACCOUNT` succeeds by its key, it sets `WS-INTEREST` to zero, calls `INTCALC`, computes `WS-INTEREST` as `WS-INTEREST-CENTS / 100`, adds `WS-INTEREST` to `CA-BALANCE`, performs `POST-INTEREST`, calls `MINPAY`, performs `WRITE-STATEMENT`, sets `CA-STATEMENT-BALANCE` to `CA-BALANCE`, sets `CA-PAID-IN-FULL` to `'N'`, rewrites `CARD-ACCOUNT`, and adds 1 to `WS-CLOSED-COUNT`.
